text:
Maya - Marketing: Hey team — we need to lock the webinar topic and speaker roster for Apr 28. Quick poll: which narrative wins: 1) Practical inference economics (benchmarks + cost levers), 2) Serving beyond scale (routing/fallbacks), 3) Private deployment patterns (VPC/on-prem examples). I want a clear CTA and 2 short demos. Link: https://docs.google.com/somewhere (agenda draft)
Liam - Content: I vote #1 — ties directly to benchmark narrative we've been pushing. Can sketch a short 3-slide narrative: problem, levers (batching/cache/quant), customer example. :thumbsup:
Raj - Product: +1 to #1 but we need a 10–12min segment showing Dedicated vs Private decision flow. Customers ask about tradeoffs a lot. Can do a short decision tree.
Sofia - Speaker Ops: Availability check — Ava (SRE) ok Apr 28, Chen (ML Infra) free but limited to 30 mins; Diego (Customer PM) prefers morning PT. If we do #1 we should include a customer voice (Diego) + one runtime engineer for demos.
Jen - Prod-Marketing: Run-of-show draft: (we should confirm demo infra + fallback plan)

```
00:00 - 00:05  Intro + positioning (Maya)
00:05 - 00:15  Benchmark highlights & economics (Liam)
00:15 - 00:30  Live demo: Dedicated vs Private tradeoffs (Chen + Diego)
00:30 - 00:40  Ops deep-dive: batching/caching knobs (Ava)
00:40 - 00:55  Q&A + CTA / demo link
00:55 - 01:00  Close
```

Maya - Marketing: Perfect start. Two asks: (1) can someone write a 2-paragraph abstract we can use for registration? (2) confirm demos are reproducible in a 10–12min window and we have a fallback recorded clip.
Chen - ML Infra: Demo plan — I can run a short script showing latency/cost delta with/without batching. Need a small dataset and a pinned model version. Will prepare `scripts/demo_batch_vs_no_batch.sh` and a pre-recorded run as fallback.
Ava - SRE: Ops deep-dive will be non-CLI heavy. I'll prepare visuals of routing policies + an example failover path. For rehearsal, I need 45 mins with Chen to sync handoffs.
Diego - Customer PM: Happy to do customer perspective + 3 metrics (latency, cost, reliability). Can provide a short case slide. Morning PT is best.
Liam - Content: Abstract draft (2 pars): "Join Redwood Inference for a practical look at inference economics — how teams cut per-token costs while keeping latency predictable. We’ll share benchmark insights, demo real-world levers (batching, caching, routing), and walk through a customer case study of moving from hosted to dedicated/private deployments." "Attendees will leave with concrete next steps and a decision framework to pick the right deployment mode for their workload." Please tweak.
Maya - Marketing: Good draft — Jen, can you condense to two registration blurbs (short + long) by EOD?
Jen - Prod-Marketing: On it. Short blurb done: "Practical inference economics: real benchmarks, demoed levers, customer playbook." Long blurb will be ready in 3 hours.
Sofia - Speaker Ops: Rehearsal windows: Tue Apr 21 10:00–11:00 PT (full run), Thu Apr 23 09:00–09:30 PT (tech check). @Ava @Chen @Diego pls confirm.
RehearsalBot: Scheduled rehearsal: Tue Apr 21 10:00 PT — calendar invites sent to participants.
Ava - SRE: Confirmed for both.
Chen - ML Infra: Confirmed — will upload demo artifacts to the shared folder and pin model v1.2.
Diego - Customer PM: Confirmed Tue morning.
Maya - Marketing: Final items: slides due Apr 19 EOD, demo artifacts Apr 20 EOD, rehearsal agenda uploaded to the doc. Who owns the registration questions/landing page? @Jen
Jen - Prod-Marketing: I’ll own landing page + registration flows. I'll add UTM params and an optional pre-webinar survey (2 q's).
Liam - Content: I'll draft three teaser tweets and a short blog blurb once we have the final title.
Maya - Marketing: Title candidates: "Practical Inference Economics" (clean), "Serving Smarter: Cost + Latency Tradeoffs" (marketing-y). Vote in thread by noon. Also, we need a short CTA: request demo or sign up for dedicated trial.
Raj - Product: Leaning toward the clean title. CTA: "Get a dedicated trial" + link to contact form.
Maya - Marketing: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll consolidate notes and update the doc. If no objections, title locks at noon PT and Jen will publish landing page draft by EOD. :rocket:
